title: EU sets out a new Strategy for the Arctic
summary: European Commission Press release Strasbourg, 20 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy presented a new Strategy for the Arctic. The Strategy presents a new framework of political cooperation for like-minded partners that places people, security, climate and prosperity at its core.
